column3: “Nile” specifies the watercourses; “water” renders the sea in the last phrase.
“Her allies” replaces the second person “your help”.
“Troops” renders “people”; “like” is supplied, and “their bars” replaces “your bars”.
“Repair the brick kiln” replaces taking hold of the brick mold.
“Your downfall” is supplied as the object of applause.
